E01.text:
# Initial event notification

**SYNTHETIC RESEARCH FIXTURE. Not an authentic company record.**

Record: E01 | Case: FCB-01 | Asset: RB-3
Record owner: Outage incident desk
Coverage: Day 0, approximately 13:03

## Notification
A raised delivery carrier beam fell into the roughing-stand pit and struck an equipment sled and temporary scaffold. No person was in the pit at the time of the fall. Contractors had worked in the area earlier in the shift. Guide-box work was in progress during a planned outage.

## Immediate record
The area was closed following the event. The fallen assembly remained in the pit pending recovery. The notification does not include measurements or a failure-mechanism determination.

## Contact
The outage coordinator can route requests to the shift supervisor, maintenance records, engineering records, and controls archive. Investigators may submit a description of the information needed without knowing the record title.

E02.text:
# Carrier assembly functional description

**SYNTHETIC RESEARCH FIXTURE. Not an authentic company record.**

Record: E02 | Case: FCB-01 | Asset: RB-3
Record owner: Engineering records
Coverage: Baseline arrangement before Day 0

## Assembly
The carrier is connected through link arms to hydraulic lifting yokes. The yokes raise and lower the carrier. The baseline arrangement has one keeper plate on each link arm. A keeper is intended to retain engagement within its specified operating geometry.

## Operating envelope
The normal operating arrangement includes the backup rolls. Outage arrangements may remove components that delimit the normal travel envelope. This description is not an as-found survey of the Day 0 equipment.

## Information ownership
Engineering records maintains geometry and configuration material. Maintenance records holds work instructions and completed job packs. Shift operations retains handover records. Controls retains available operating logs. Temporary-work and isolation records are held by the outage coordinator.

E03.text:
# Issued guide-box work pack excerpt

**SYNTHETIC RESEARCH FIXTURE. Not an authentic company record.**

Record: E03 | Case: FCB-01 | Asset: RB-3
Record owner: Maintenance records
Coverage: Work order GB-42, issued Day 0 at 09:40

## Scope and issue
Asset RB-3. Task: guide-box replacement. Issued copy: procedure GB-17, revision C. The issue receipt identifies this copy as the pack supplied to the work team.

## Preparation entries
Entry 10:20: backup-roll removal complete, previous-turn handover accepted. Entry 10:42: top roll balance raised for guide-box clearance. Local isolation recorded at valve tag IV-RB3-17. The form labels this function "A hydraulics".

## Mechanical restraint field
The issued page contains an electrical/hydraulic isolation checklist. There is no separate field on this page identifying a fitted pin, block, or crib. The additional-task-precautions attachment is referenced on the cover but is not present in this copy.

## Recorded execution
The local valve position is checked "closed" at 10:47. The copy does not contain a sealing test result. Signatures record acceptance of the local preparation checklist.

# Front-camera observation worksheet

**SYNTHETIC RESEARCH FIXTURE. Not an authentic company record.**

Record: E05 | Case: FCB-01 | Asset: RB-3
Record owner: Video custodian
Coverage: Camera F3, Day 0 before and during the event

## Worksheet conditions
Review performed on an archived fixed-camera view. Pixel coordinates below refer to identified image landmarks, not calibrated physical displacement. The downward image direction is positive. Estimated landmark reading tolerance: 2 pixels. The housing datum did not shift by more than 1 pixel during the reviewed interval.

## Landmark readings
Time | Housing datum y | Yoke marker y | Carrier marker y
11:03 | 100 | 210 | 190
11:52 | 100 | 238 | 190
12:45 | 100 | 272 | 191
13:02:58 | 100 | 289 | 190
13:03:02 | 100 | obscured | carrier leaves upper opening

## Visible limits
The upper carrier edge contacts the housing in this view. The contact surface and link-arm lateral offset are not resolved. No branch hydraulic pressure is visible. A second oblique view is listed in the camera index.

E12.text:
# Oblique-camera observation worksheet

**SYNTHETIC RESEARCH FIXTURE. Not an authentic company record.**

Record: E12 | Case: FCB-01 | Asset: RB-3
Record owner: Video custodian
Coverage: Camera O3, same event interval as F3

## Identification
The camera index assigns O3 to the RB-3 upper housing. Fixed posts and the carrier markings are visible in the frames reviewed. This is a written observation worksheet; raw frames are not included in this fixture.

## Observations
11:03: upper carrier is against the housing; the visible link arm is near the centre-line reference. 12:45: carrier remains held at the upper housing; the visible link arm has moved outward relative to that reference. 13:02:58: outward displacement remains visible while the lifting yoke is lower than in the 11:03 frame. The final interface is obscured during release.

## Limits
The worksheet does not measure the outward displacement in millimetres and does not resolve contact across the hidden keeper face. The event clock was cross-checked to the front-camera record.

E07.text:
# Geometry worksheet for the baseline connection

**SYNTHETIC RESEARCH FIXTURE. Not an authentic company record.**

Record: E07 | Case: FCB-01 | Asset: RB-3
Record owner: Engineering records
Coverage: Baseline single-keeper configuration; examination after Day 0

## Configuration
Worksheet GEO-17 applies to the original connection with one link-arm keeper and no added yoke keeper. Wear measurements and the nominal centred-resting position were included.

## Centred check
At the centred-resting position, the measured condition leaves overlap that prevents the link arm from passing the keeper/yoke interface by the straight withdrawal considered in this worksheet. The measured wear does not remove that overlap.

## Offset-pose check
For a prescribed outward link-arm displacement, the baseline model permits loss of keeper/yoke overlap. Lowering the yoke relative to a carrier held in that offset pose permits disengagement in the idealised check. This is a conditional kinematic check; the worksheet does not contain an observation establishing that the prescribed pose occurred on Day 0.

## Model boundary
This fixture worksheet treats components as rigid and does not calculate transient forces or deformation. The source CAD model and a full numerical trajectory are not included in this extract.

E08.text:
# Valve workshop examination record

**SYNTHETIC RESEARCH FIXTURE. Not an authentic company record.**

Record: E08 | Case: FCB-01 | Asset: RB-3
Record owner: Hydraulic maintenance
Coverage: Day +3; tagged valve removed from RB-3

## Identification and condition
Workshop tag VAL-17 is linked to local valve IV-RB3-17 on the removal docket. The body was externally cleaned before examination. The handle indicator could be placed at the closed position.

## Bench observation
With the handle at closed and differential pressure applied from the cylinder-side port toward the supply-side port, fluid seepage was observed. No calibrated leakage-rate trace accompanies this record.

## Time scope
The examination was carried out after removal, three days after the event. The record contains no installed-state pressure trace for Day 0 and no dated record establishing when the observed internal condition developed.

E06.text:
# Recovered assembly inspection entry

**SYNTHETIC RESEARCH FIXTURE. Not an authentic company record.**

Record: E06 | Case: FCB-01 | Asset: RB-3
Record owner: Mechanical examination
Coverage: Day 0 recovery; original incident assembly

## Identification
Recovery tag REC-31 identifies the original RB-3 delivery carrier assembly. The tag was attached at the pit before transfer to the inspection area.

## Inspection observations
The keeper plate remained bolted to the recovered link arm. No gross fracture or missing portion of that plate was recorded. Wear and rubbing marks were observed at the link-arm/yoke contact areas. The report does not contain an incident-time displacement measurement.

## Disposition
The original assembly was retained for engineering examination. A replacement carrier was prepared separately.
